new_lead.title: Careers in Your Community Challenge
verified_facts: The U.S. Department of Education challenge opened August 4, 2026 at 9:00 AM ET and submissions close November 19, 2026 at 6:00 PM ET.
The total cash prize pool is $50,000; the Department anticipates selecting up to ten winners and dividing the pool equally among them.
Entrants submit on behalf of a school and must meet the Perkins V Eligible Recipient requirements referenced by the official rules.
The entrant must provide documentation that the school principal or district-level administrator permits entry.
The designated team lead must be employed as a CTE teacher, coordinator, or director at the school and must be at least 18 years old.
Judging scores five published criteria up to five points each: career pathway knowledge, impact, feasibility, community connection, and student engagement.
If there are more than 30 submissions, the Department may use a two-tier review; otherwise it may conduct only Tier 2.

Entrants retain ownership of their submission subject to the challenge licenses; winning submissions grant the Department a nonexclusive, nontransferable, irrevocable, paid-up worldwide license for Federal purposes in perpetuity.
Winners are responsible for applicable taxes, and entrants accept release/indemnification terms described in the official rules.
new_lead.entry_cost: No entry fee was identified in the reviewed official rules; participation is restricted to qualifying school entrants and requires teacher/school administrative involvement.
new_lead.eligibility_gate: This is not a generic individual earning opportunity. It is intended for qualifying high-school/CTE school entrants under Perkins V, with an adult CTE teacher/coordinator/director as team lead and school authorization.
new_lead.recommended_action: Preserve as specialized opportunity intelligence. Do not create generic active work unless an eligible school/team is identified. After older source snapshots are replayed chronologically, publish a concise canonical intelligence item if the challenge remains open and the official rules are unchanged.
